name: Data Classification and Handling Policy
description: Defines how information is classified, and what handling, transmission, storage, and movement restrictions apply at each classification level.
purpose: Give the protection controls a basis for deciding what to protect and how strongly, so that requirements are proportionate rather than uniform or arbitrary.
scope_guidance: Should cover information in all states and locations, and should enumerate the routes by which information can leave the environment.

required_elements.element: Classification levels with concrete examples of what falls into each
required_elements.rationale: Abstract levels produce inconsistent classification and therefore inconsistent protection.

required_elements.element: Handling requirements per level for storage, transmission, and sharing
required_elements.rationale: This is what makes the classification consequential rather than decorative.

required_elements.element: Enumeration of routes by which information can leave the environment
required_elements.rationale: Restriction is impossible without first knowing the routes; most entities discover routes they had not considered.

required_elements.element: Authorisation required for bulk export or transfer, and who may authorise it
required_elements.rationale: Bulk movement is the highest-impact egress and is frequently unauthorised by process.

required_elements.element: Removable media stance, and whether it is technically enforced
required_elements.rationale: A policy statement with no enforcement mechanism evidences intent only.

required_elements.element: Requirements for sharing information with third parties
required_elements.rationale: External sharing is a route that internal egress controls often do not cover.

required_elements.element: Retention and disposal requirements per classification
required_elements.rationale: Connects handling to the sanitization control.

required_elements.element: Requirements for production data in non-production environments
required_elements.rationale: A common route by which protected information leaves the controlled environment without leaving the entity.

required_elements.element: Named policy owner, approval record, and review cadence
required_elements.rationale: An unapproved or undated policy is treated as a documentation deficiency.

approval_expectation.approver_role: Executive accountable for security (CISO or equivalent)

communication_expectation: Communicated to all personnel handling information, and acknowledged at onboarding. Relevant to the CC2 communication criteria as well as to CC6.7.
common_gaps: Classification levels defined but no differentiated handling requirements, so classification changes nothing.
Egress routes not enumerated, so restriction is asserted rather than designed.
Removable media prohibited in policy with no endpoint enforcement.
Production data in non-production environments unaddressed.

source_refs.supports: The criteria the controls this policy documents contribute to.
The required_elements model. SOC 2 prescribes no policy contents.

notes: Data loss prevention tooling is not required by SOC 2 and this policy does not assume it. An entity with few egress routes may meet the objective through architecture and access restriction.
